answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 31900 Country: India Title: Woman married 5 years back after that lady left husband without talak can the woman marry again without divorce her husband? Question: Woman married 5 years back after that lady left husband without talak can the woman marry again without divorce her husband? Answer ID: 31900 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 917/917/M=1432) According to Shariah, only males are authorized to give talaq. الطلاق لمن أخذ بالساق (الحديث) A woman cannot give talaq to her husband. A woman cannot marry another man until her husband does not give her talaq or they do not agree for Khula with mutual consent. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
